reason: I already screenshot every transfer and keep a spreadsheet that does the job, so the free part is enough for me. I would have to set up an iPhone Shortcut and hand my bank and card details to a new app, and for that effort I would rather just keep my spreadsheet going.
objection: Why would I give a new app my bank slips and card statement when my own spreadsheet already works and I know exactly where my data is?
would_change_my_mind: A clear, short explanation of what is stored and where, plus a setup that takes a few minutes and works on my phone without a lot of steps.
